topic: What beam switching strategies minimize setup times while maintaining spectrum efficiency for multi-satellite ground station operations?
response: To minimize setup times while maintaining spectrum efficiency for multi-satellite ground station operations, consider implementing dynamic beam switching strategies that adapt to real-time traffic demands.
